the design of a gastroretentive, sustained-release dosage form for dipyridamol.

the floating alginate bead system with solid dispersions of Eudragits RLPO and L100 could effectively prolong gastric retention of dipyridamoie, and the floating alginate system could be an alternative approach to enhance the oral bioavailability of drugs with low solubility.

the floating alginate bead combined with the solid dispersions technique is a promising method for the development of gastroretentively sustained-release dosage forms.

the solid dispersion technique could be used as a promising method for improving the dissolution of acid-labile drugs, and the floating alginate bead system could prolong gastric residence time, which is beneficial to the absorption of acid-sensitive drugs.
